title: Making the Colour Purple: The Science of Art | National Gallery
speaker: The National Gallery
zh: 【The National Gallery】使顏色變成紫色：藝術科學|國家美術館（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In painting, the colour purple was traditionally achieved by artists mixing red and blue pigments together.
cues.en: In painting, the colour purple was traditionally achieved by artists mixing red and blue pigments together.
cues.zh: 在繪畫中，紫色傳統上是由藝術家將紅色和藍色顏料混合在一起獲得的。

cues.text: Different mixtures resulted in purples of varying intensities and shades.
cues.en: Different mixtures resulted in purples of varying intensities and shades.
cues.zh: 不同的混合物產生不同強度和色調的紫色。

cues.text: But how can the separate ingredients of a purple be identified?
cues.en: But how can the separate ingredients of a purple be identified?
cues.zh: 但如何辨識紫色的不同成分呢？

cues.text: At the National Gallery Scientific Department a tiny sample of paint, usually taken from
cues.en: At the National Gallery Scientific Department a tiny sample of paint, usually taken from
cues.zh: 在國家美術館科學部，有一個微小的油漆樣本，通常取自

cues.text: the edge or from underneath the frame of a picture, is immersed in resin, dried, and
cues.en: the edge or from underneath the frame of a picture, is immersed in resin, dried, and
cues.zh: 將邊緣或畫框下方浸入樹脂中，乾燥，然後

cues.text: then polished to produce a cross-section.
cues.en: then polished to produce a cross-section.
cues.zh: 然後拋光以產生橫截面。

cues.text: This cross-section can be examined at high magnification under a microscope.
cues.en: This cross-section can be examined at high magnification under a microscope.
cues.zh: 此橫截面可以在顯微鏡下以高放大倍率進行檢查。

cues.text: This sample clearly shows separate blue and red pigment particles. Other methods of examination
cues.en: This sample clearly shows separate blue and red pigment particles. Other methods of examination
cues.zh: 該樣品清楚地顯示了單獨的藍色和紅色顏料顆粒。其他檢查方法

cues.text: tell us even more.
cues.en: tell us even more.
cues.zh: 告訴我們更多。

cues.text: This scanning electron microscope, coupled with an energy dispersive x-ray analyser,
cues.en: This scanning electron microscope, coupled with an energy dispersive x-ray analyser,
cues.zh: 此掃描電子顯微鏡與能量色散 X 射線分析儀結合，

cues.text: can determine the composition of the pigments.
cues.en: can determine the composition of the pigments.
cues.zh: 可以確定顏料的組成。

cues.text: The blue pigment in this purple paint contains copper, identifying it as the mineral azurite.
cues.en: The blue pigment in this purple paint contains copper, identifying it as the mineral azurite.
cues.zh: 這種紫色顏料中的藍色顏料含有銅，將其識別為礦物藍銅礦。

cues.text: The red pigment contains aluminium, which is characteristic of what are known as 'red lake' pigments.
cues.en: The red pigment contains aluminium, which is characteristic of what are known as 'red lake' pigments.
cues.zh: 紅色顏料含有鋁，這是所謂的「紅湖」顏料的特徵。

cues.text: The colour in red lake comes from the dyestuff in insects such as kermes or cochineal, or
cues.en: The colour in red lake comes from the dyestuff in insects such as kermes or cochineal, or
cues.zh: 紅湖的顏色來自昆蟲的染料，如胭脂紅或胭脂紅，或者

cues.text: plants such as madder root.
cues.en: plants such as madder root.
cues.zh: 植物，如茜草根。

cues.text: Analysing a red lake using high performance liquid chromatography
cues.en: Analysing a red lake using high performance liquid chromatography
cues.zh: 使用高效液相層析分析紅湖

cues.text: can identify which of these materials were used.
cues.en: can identify which of these materials were used.
cues.zh: 可以辨識使用了哪些材料。

cues.text: To understand the ways in which a colour could have been obtained, members of the Department use historical recipes to prepare pigments.
cues.en: To understand the ways in which a colour could have been obtained, members of the Department use historical recipes to prepare pigments.
cues.zh: 為了了解獲得顏色的方法，該部門的成員使用歷史配方來製備顏料。

cues.text: This is a 19th century method for obtaining red lake from madder root.
cues.en: This is a 19th century method for obtaining red lake from madder root.
cues.zh: 這是 19 世紀從茜草根中獲取紅湖的方法。

cues.text: Red lake pigments are particularly prone to fading on exposure to light.
cues.en: Red lake pigments are particularly prone to fading on exposure to light.
cues.zh: 紅色色澱顏料在光照下特別容易褪色。

cues.text: In this portrait of a young princess by Jan Gossaert the blue pattern on the sleeves was
cues.en: In this portrait of a young princess by Jan Gossaert the blue pattern on the sleeves was
cues.zh: 在揚·戈薩爾特 (Jan Gossaert) 創作的這幅年輕公主的肖像中，袖子上的藍色圖案是

cues.text: originally purple. The red lake pigment Gossaert mixed with blue azurite has almost entirely
cues.en: originally purple. The red lake pigment Gossaert mixed with blue azurite has almost entirely
cues.zh: 原本是紫色的。紅色色澱顏料戈薩爾與藍色藍銅礦混合幾乎完全

cues.text: faded and the original colour is now only visible at the edge, where the paint has been
cues.en: faded and the original colour is now only visible at the edge, where the paint has been
cues.zh: 褪色，原始顏色現在僅在油漆已塗過的邊緣可見

cues.text: protected from light.
cues.en: protected from light.
cues.zh: 避光。

cues.text: The Scientific Department's contribution to understanding the materials, behaviour and
cues.en: The Scientific Department's contribution to understanding the materials, behaviour and
cues.zh: 科學部門對理解材料、行為和

cues.text: stability of colour helps conservators and curators not only understand how the paintings
cues.en: stability of colour helps conservators and curators not only understand how the paintings
cues.zh: 顏色的穩定性不僅可以幫助管理者和策展人瞭解畫作的性質

cues.text: in the collection have changed over time, but also how best to preserve them for the future.
cues.en: in the collection have changed over time, but also how best to preserve them for the future.
cues.zh: 收藏品隨著時間的推移而發生了變化，而且還討論瞭如何最好地儲存它們以供將來使用。
